reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(c.category_id) AS n_tv_lines
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video'
GROUP BY s.store_code

other_way.sql: SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(l.order_line_id) AS n_tv_lines FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00' JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' RIGHT JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_code
other_way.tradeoff: Joining the week's TV & Video lines with inner joins, then keeping every store with RIGHT JOIN, avoids four LEFT JOINs.

solver.query:
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(tv.order_line_id) AS n_tv_lines
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT o.store_id, l.order_line_id
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
) tv ON tv.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
